new.rationale: Today Draw a Flag! (25 days) is the third-best Top Trending climber (+17) despite a 51% like ratio, Survive Your Ideas (29 days) entered Up-and-Coming, and Monster Maker and Paint the Flag were profiled as new; Make a Cartoon! entered Up-and-Coming on 2026-11-01. Confirm if more such games enter the breakout charts over the next two weeks and hold mid-chart positions; refute if they fall off within a week like the everyday-device wave.
